Roast
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 4 potatoes
  • 4 carrots-skin peeled and chopped into big 3 inch chunks
  • 1 beef chuck roast (bone or boneless is fine)
  • 2 white onion-peeled and cut into rings
  • 1 lipton's dry onion soup
  • 8 Clove(s) garlic, minced
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) olive oil
  • 2 Cup(s) water
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) adolf's meat tenderizer with seasoning
Instructions
  1. Rub chuck roast with olive oil on both sides (this seals in the juices). Cover with meat tenderizer on both sides and poke roast with fork to work the oil and tenderizer in the roast. Rub roast with garlic on both sides.
  2. Place roast in roasting pan (pan needs to have a lid that covers tightly). Place potatoes in next, followed by carrots and then onions. Sprinkle onion soup mix over the top and fill with 2 inches of water.
  3. Cook at 300 degrees for 5 hours.
